cards.example_en: We will build a small bookshelf for my bedroom.
cards.example_zh: 我们要为我的卧室做一个小书架。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：忙碌的
cards.example_en: The busy waiter forgot our soup during the lunch rush.
cards.example_zh: 忙碌的服务员在午饭高峰时忘了我们的汤。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：携带；搬运
cards.example_en: Two students carry the heavy box up to the classroom.
cards.example_zh: 两个学生把这个重箱子搬到教室去。

cards.example_en: Wet roads can cause accidents near our school.
cards.example_zh: 湿滑的路面可能在我们学校附近引发事故。

cards.example_en: Check your answers before you hand in the paper.
cards.example_zh: 交卷之前先把答案检查一遍。

cards.example_en: Choose a story you really want to read tonight.
cards.example_zh: 选一个你今晚真正想读的故事。

cards.example_en: She can claim her lost bag at the school office.
cards.example_zh: 她可以到学校办公室认领丢失的书包。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：联合；结合
cards.example_en: Art students combine red and blue to get purple.
cards.example_zh: 美术班的学生把红色和蓝色调成紫色。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：来；到来
cards.example_en: Come to my house after the football game.
cards.example_zh: 足球比赛结束后到我家来。

cards.example_en: Please complete this form before you leave the office.
cards.example_zh: 离开办公室前，请把这份表格填写完成。

cards.example_en: This box may contain fragile items.
cards.example_zh: 这个箱子可能装有易碎物品。

cards.example_en: Continue the story from the page where we stopped.
cards.example_zh: 从我们上次停下的那一页继续读这个故事。

cards.example_en: Everyone can contribute ideas in class.
cards.example_zh: 每个人都可以在课堂上贡献想法。

cards.example_en: Cut the apple into four pieces for the children.
cards.example_zh: 把苹果切成四块分给孩子们。

cards.example_en: Can you define this science term in simple words?
cards.example_zh: 你能用简单的话给这个科学术语下定义吗？
